title: Free Night Awards Ruling: The Forfeited Award's Share of a Late-Cancelled Night
content:
**Ruling.** Under the Free Night Awards terms, the stay's protected value of a reservation cancelled after its deadline is set from what the forfeited Free Night Award itself carried for the forfeited night, apart from any top-off points the member had added, which are lost with the award. The award's share of the forfeited night depends on the award:

- an uncapped award's share is the whole night price;
- a capped award for which top-off points were deducted for the cancelled reservation has a share of the night price less the top-off counted;
- a capped award with no top-off deducted for that reservation has a share of the lower of the night price and its points cap.

**The top-off counted.** The top-off counted reads the award's top-off entries in the member's Ashbury Rewards account: it is the top-off deducted for the cancelled reservation less any top-off returned for that reservation. Top-off deducted for or returned on any other reservation of the award never counts. The deductions are the Ashbury Rewards points redemptions posted as a Free Night Award top-off naming this award and the cancelled reservation; the returns are the top-off redeposits naming this award and that reservation.

Whether top-off "was deducted for the cancelled reservation" turns on the existence of at least one such top-off deduction naming this award and the cancelled reservation.

## Points caps of the award types

| Award type | Capped or uncapped | Points cap |
|---|---|---|
| 25K Free Night Award | Capped | 25000 |
| 35K Free Night Award | Capped | 35000 |
| 40K Free Night Award | Capped | 40000 |
| 50K Free Night Award | Capped | 50000 |
| 85K Free Night Award | Capped | 85000 |
| Any Hotel Free Night Award | Uncapped | 0 (no cap) |

## Truth table

| Award | Top-off deduction for this award and the cancelled reservation | Share of the forfeited night |
|---|---|---|
| Uncapped | Any | The whole night price |
| Capped | At least one | Night price less (deducted for this reservation less returned for this reservation) |
| Capped | None | The lower of the night price and the points cap |

## Cases (hypothetical night price of 30000 points)

| Hypothetical award and account entries | Top-off counted | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Any Hotel Free Night Award | Not read | 30000 |
| 25K Free Night Award; 5000 deducted for the cancelled reservation, nothing returned | 5000 | 25000 |
| 40K Free Night Award; 8000 deducted and 3000 returned for the cancelled reservation | 5000 | 25000 |
| 25K Free Night Award; 5000 deducted and 5000 returned for the cancelled reservation | 0 | 30000 |
| 25K Free Night Award; top-off deducted only on an earlier, different reservation | No deduction for this reservation | 25000, the lower of 30000 and the 25000 cap |
| 35K Free Night Award; no top-off deduction at all | No deduction for this reservation | 30000, the lower of 30000 and the 35000 cap |
